tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos grwa chen po chos 'khor lhun po'i bca' yig rin po che zung gi zhabs 'degs bslab bya'i gnang bkag gsal bar ston pa'i bca' yig rnam dag chos khrims gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dharma swa mi sarba dz+nyā sid+dhi shrī dz+wa la s+ya bā da ya/ sku gsum mngon gyur ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dug gsum nad sel dam chos bdud rtsi'i sman/ /bslab gsum rnam dag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na rgyal/ /tshogs gnyis dge legs chu gter las bzhengs te/ /mkhyen pa'i mkha' la brtse ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /nus mthu'i 'od kyis srid zhi'i rgud sel ba'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma nyin byed dbang po rgyal/ /rnam mang gzhung lugs chu rgyun gcig bsdus te/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rin chen gzhung bzung nas/ /skal bzang lag 'gro brgya stong skyong ba'i dpal/ /thams cad mkhyen pa klu yi dbang po rgyal/ /'dren pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bstan dang de 'dzin skyong la mi g.yel ba'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho nor lha 'khor bcas kyis/ /'phral dang yun du shis pa'i dge legs stsol/ /de la 'dir gleng bar bya ba'i gzhi ni/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol 'gro ba pa rnams kyis phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di kho na yin la/ 'di nyid kyang dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs ni/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las shing / dge 'dun rnams nas kyang 'dzin par bya ba'i gzhi ni/ slob dpon shān+ti de bas/ gtsug lag rnams ni klog pa dang / /kha ton gyis brgyan legs gnas shog

/rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar gyi/ 'khor lo gsum dang chos spyod rnam bcu'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad dgos pa yin zhing / de la yang / sngon gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi ming tsam yang med pa la/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mkhan slob lo tsā ba chos kyi spyan ldan mang du spyan drangs nas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes srol btod dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par rgyal ba nyid kyi lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi brnyes shing srid pa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba rje btsun sa skya'i yab sras khu dbon zhal slob nying slob dang bcas pas rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la 'chad nyan bsgom sgrub rnam dag gi sgo nas gtan la phab cing dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ni yid can kun gyi blo gsal ltar yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang chos rje khu dbon las brgyud de mdo phyogs kyi bshad grwa rin po che mang du 'phel ba rnams kyi nang nas/ paṇa chen gzhung brgya pa chen po'i chos grwa chen po chos 'khor lhun po 'di nyid rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed gzhung rma med pa dar zhing rgyas na ci ma rung snyam du dgongs te thugs bsam rnam dag gis 'debs par mdzad nas der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun tshang mas blang dor mdzad dgos kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pa'i bca' yig khyad par can dang bcas 'dzugs par mdzad pa la de skabs nas bzung yun mi thung tsam zhig dar rgyas che bar byung mod/ bar skabs zhig tu yid srub kyi gnas lam snying la bcas pa'i ban gzugs 'ga' re'i byed spyod ngan pa la brten/ mkhan grwa thugs nang mi gshis pa sogs bstan pa'i mig rgyan la gnod nges 'ga' re byung ba la/

kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gzhung brgya pa chen po'i bca' yig la rgyab snon zhal 'debs bka' drin che bas mig ltos ngan pa mtha' dag 'gags te phan slebs che ba byung mod/ de rjes su mkhan thog 'pho 'gyur mang ba dang de rnams kyis kyang bla brang du nag chang bsten pa sogs mdzad sgo 'dra min sna tshogs shig mdzad 'dug par chos khrims pa rnams nas de bzhin gnang na chos sde'i lar rgyar gnod nges tshul zhus kyang gsan dgongs med pa'i res bor la brten grwa tshang rnams kyang sgyid skyur gyi rnam pas nag chang 'dzems med lkog glu 'then pa sogs yod tshul thos pas rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa gang la'ang chud zos byung na nges spun gnyis gong ma'i gdan sar skyes kyang dgos pa cher ma byung bas/ des na me chung gsod kyi dpes mkhan gsar bkra shis yar 'phel 'di nyid gzhung brgya pa'i gdan sar mnga' gsol gyi thog chos khrims bca' yig cig de khar 'bul 'dun che yang brel g.yengs kyis rim 'gyangs su lus par/ mkhan rin po che nas kyang myur du dgos tshul yang yang bskul ma gnang ba ltar/ don gyi snying po dge 'dun pa rnams thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba ni shin tu gal che zhing / bca' yig gong ma gnyis na yang zhib rgyas bzhugs mod kyang / dge 'dun tshang ma'i thugs la mi gsal ba'am/ yang na mkhan po dbu chos sogs kyi bca' yig bzhin bsgrig 'chur ma byung ba lta bus sngar phan bla brang dang grwa shag rnams su bud med btsun ma sogs bag med rang du sdod pa zhig byung 'dug pas/ da cha nye rigs dang mgron po khag chen byung na chos khrims par snang ba zhus pas nyin phrad ma gtogs mtshan zhag sdod mi byed/

gal te lkog bsubs kyis byas pa shar tshe chos khrims pas mkhan por zhus pa'i nyes tshabs che chung la dpag brgya phyag sogs chad pa gang rigs 'gel/ 'di ga'i dus mdos skabs nyer gsum nas gnam gang bar la las tshan la 'dzem zhag dang dgongs pa zhus pa'i mgron chang phran bu dang sbyin bdag nag mo'i gras ngo 'dzin dgos pa la sne len gang dgos nyin mo byas nas mtshan mo zhol gyi khyim khrod gang rigs su gnas tshang la gnyer dam bya zhing grwa shag tu sdod mi 'jug gnam gang dgong myur la bla brang sku tshab chos khrims pa bcas nas gling yul rgyab pa'i nag chang gi 'grim 'grul gcod dgos/ bla brang gi 'u lag dge 'dun gyi las sne lud skyel sogs dgos pa byung tshe chos khrims par dgongs zhus kyi babs bltas pa'i nag mo dang btsun ma'i rigs nyin gtong mtshan zhag sdod mi byed/ grwa tshang spyi bsod kyi mgo mi thang re tsam byas nas/ gzhis dgon dang yul du sdod pa sogs yod 'dra bas/ dgon par 'os babs kyi chos khrims lan gnyis re khyer nas dgongs pa nam grol bar la phan tshun gang du yang 'gro sa med cing / snga sor myos byed kyi btung ba dang bag med dang / mi nag dkyus 'gro'i glu sogs byed pa yod 'dug pas/ da cha bdud las de rigs gtan mi byed cing / 'dul khrims la'ang 'di las nyes tshabs che ba med pa 'dul lung la gsal ba ltar phyin chad sman chang sogs phran bu ma gtogs bab chol du mi 'thung / gal te rtsis med kyi rigs byung tshe mkhan po dbu chos sogs las sne rnams bgros pa'i thog nas nyes tshabs che chung la dpag pa'i lugs mthun gyi chad pa 'gel/ mi tshangs spyod kyi char gtogs 'khrig tshig tsam yang mi smra zhing / gal te bslab tshul la skyon byung na/ mkhan dbu chos sogs las sne nas rtsad gcod kyi chad pa grwa tshang du mang ja gsum re/ mkhan por mar dos gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ spyi par dge 'dun gyi ja rdor la phan pa'i mar zho gsum dang lnga tshan/

mgon khang du bshags rten bskang gso/ gtsug lag khang rnams su mchod pa snyan shal bcas rnams sgrub pa'i mthar sdom snying / 'bul chog gis gsar pa len pa'am/ yang na dgon der sdod mi 'jug brku ba'i bsam pas dkon mchog gsum dang pha ma nye 'brel gzhan ma'i rigs nas phul gang du longs pa yang mi brku/ nye ring chags na gong bzhin las tshan rnams nas rkun 'jal sogs dang chad pa'i babs thob lta/ srog gcod kyi char gtogs chen po lta ci smos grog sbur tsam yang mi gsod/ gal te bdud kyis bslad pas dmar khe byed pa sogs byung na mi tshangs spyod dang cha 'dra'i chad pa 'gel/ de ma yin pa'i 'dul khrims mtha' dag ma sdom pa nod pa'i tshe/ mkhan pos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa bzhin srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed/ dgon gnas dkrugs pa'i bsam sbyor gyi las tshan la bsdo ba/ gzhan rigs la mgo gtad byas pa/ bsam ngan dug sbyor gyi las rtsom pa sogs byas pa byung na/ de rigs la hor khrims kyi rtsa rang rang gnad du che yang chos sde rnams nas chad pa'i tha ma gnas dbyung yin pas dge 'dun gyi mdo sgrub dang gan rdung gi mtshams gcod/ mgon khang du snyan dar zhal khra can sogs drag po'i phrin 'chol gyi mtha' 'doms gal che/ mkhan po dbu chos spyi pa bu chen/ dgon khag gi bla rigs sogs sne mor mngags pa rnams dang dge 'dun tshang mas spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa/ bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed gzhung 'khrul med gzhung brgya pa chen po'i bzhed srol bshad grwa rin po che dang / sngags kyi bshad nyan la thos bsam sgom gsum g.yel ba med pa'i ngos 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i thabs gong ma gong ma'i ngag la 'og ma 'og ma rnams kyis nyan pa gal che zhing / mkhan chen gtso gyur gyi las tshan rnams nas kyang dkon mchog rin po che dpang bzhag gi bstan 'gro la bde skyid dang / rang gzhan la 'di phyir phan pa'i thabs tshul kho na ma gtogs/

ngo dkar nag drag zhan nye rigs las tshan gsal bkod kyi thog dgos med la me 'bar chu dkrugs lta bu'i rigs mi bya zhing / gal te byas pa byung na grwa tshang spyi pa nas 'di gar gang ci'i 'tshams mol bas 'di nas kyang mchog gsum dpang bzhag yin min bltas pa'i nyes pa gang yin gyi steng du chad pa 'gel lugs byed nges yin pas gong ltar bca' yig rnying pa gnyis dang gang 'khod tshang ma chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i srung sdom tshul bzhin mkhan po/ dbu chos/ grwa tshang bcas nas mdzad pa mkhyen zhu/ na mo gu ru shrī mahā kā la ye/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ stobs 'phrog rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa/ bka' bstod gnod sbyin yab yum/ las mdzad mon pa lcam sring / bka' 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dang / khyad par kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po gzhung brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyi chos grwa chen po chos 'khor lhun po 'di nyid mi nyams shing gnyer gtad bka' bsgos pa'i srung ma'i dbang po ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams/ rdo rje 'chang nas bzung bdag cag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bar du byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa de 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde bcas dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bye brag chos grwa chen po chos 'khor lhun po 'di nyid du rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed gzhung dri med gzhung brgya pa chen po'i bzhed srol khyad par can mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan thams cad dar zhing rgyas te/

mdor na gzhung brgya pa nyid kyi sku dus dang mtshungs par mdzad du gsol/ de dang 'brel chags pa'i zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i chog rgyun rnam dag mchis pa rnams kyang mi nyams gong 'phel du 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ dgon pa 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i bla grwa rnams thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba dang / thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas nyin mtshan phyogs dus kun tu dam pa'i chos kyis snang ba khyad par can la rtogs pa dge ba phun sum tshogs pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ bstan 'gro la phan pa lhur bzhes pa'i mkhan grwa thams cad kyi sku tshe dang sku bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / dam chos thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyang tshe bsod dpal 'byor rigs rgyud thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar de srid du dgon gnas mchod pa'i mthu dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bzhugs kyi mkhan dbu chos grwa mang sbyin bdag sogs su thad nas bstan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i rigs byung na ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis bla ma gong ma'i bka' bsgo dran par mdzod la zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na de ma thag gnod byed 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skyobs pa'i lha dang phrol/ mdza' ba'i bshes dang phyes/ mkho ba'i yo byad gtor/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa yi brten phur phyung / tshe'i 'du byed bskums/ snying khrag zhal du bzhes/ rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod/ yul dang khang khyim shig ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ dus kyi 'thor rlung gis rjes med du gtor te skad cig nyid la rtags mtshan drag po kun gyis mngon du thong la phyin chad dgon gnas 'dir bdud rigs dang bdud kyis bslad pa'i ser skya'i rigs gtan nas mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/

mdor na 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad rtsa brgyud bla mas bsgos bzhin bsgrubs nas mthar thug bdag gzhan ma gyur 'gro ba thams cad sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gong 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa'i rigs rus khyad par can du skyes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas spyi bye brag gi bstan pa rin po che la phan pa'i bsam pas pra dza pa ti ste skyes bdag ces pa lcags mo lug gi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bla brang mthong smon phun tshogs gling gi rang gi bsam gtan khang bu/ thos bsam nyi 'od snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'khon sa skya pa'i chab 'bangs su skyes pa gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ chos grwa chen po chos 'khor lhun po'i bca' yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
